summary: 6-phase execution strategy for hero landing page implementation. Phases 1-5 use developer agent, Phase 6 uses browser agent. All phases are sequential with dependency enforcement.

parallelGroups.description: Independent foundation tasks - can run in parallel

tasks.description: Add medical blue CSS variables to src/index.css

sequentialTasks.description: Install shadcn/ui components: input, label, dialog, navigation-menu, sheet, avatar, badge, separator
Add medical button variant to src/components/ui/button.tsx

promptTemplate.context: Read memory HERO_LANDING_SPRINT_01_FOUNDATION for detailed implementation guide
tasks: 1. Add medical blue CSS variables to src/index.css (--medical-blue, --medical-blue-foreground, --medical-blue-light, --medical-blue-dark, --trust-green) in :root section with oklch values. Add dark mode variants in .dark selector. Add @theme inline mappings.
3. Install shadcn components: npx shadcn@latest add input label dialog navigation-menu sheet avatar badge separator
4. Add 'medical' and 'medical-outline' button variants to src/components/ui/button.tsx in buttonVariants cva config
acceptanceCriteria: Medical blue colors visible in CSS variables with oklch values
All 8 shadcn components installed in src/components/ui/

parallelGroups.description: Container must be created first (dependency for Nav/Footer)
NavigationBar and Footer can be created in parallel (both depend on Container)

tasks.description: Create NavigationBar component with Stethoscope logo, nav links, and mobile Sheet menu
Create Footer component with 4-column grid and compliance badges

promptTemplate.context: Read memory HERO_LANDING_SPRINT_02_LAYOUT for detailed implementation guide. Container, NavigationBar, Footer components.
tasks: 1. Create Container.tsx wrapper with container mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 max-w-7xl classes (~15 lines)
2. Create NavigationBar.tsx with Stethoscope icon, nav links (Features, Testimonials, Pricing, About), Login/Request Demo buttons, responsive Sheet for mobile (~90 lines)
3. Create Footer.tsx with 4-column grid (brand, services, company, compliance), Shield/Lock icons for HIPAA/SSL badges (~85 lines)
4. Create index.ts barrel export for all three components
acceptanceCriteria: Container provides consistent max-width and padding
NavigationBar shows medical blue branding (Stethoscope icon)
Footer has 4-column grid layout with compliance badges
All components use medical theme colors

parallelGroups.description: All 4 landing sections can be created in parallel (all depend only on phase-2 completion)

tasks.description: Create HeroSection with gradient background, HIPAA badge, headline, stats, CTAs
Create FeaturesSection with 6 feature cards and icons
Create CTASection with full-width medical blue background

promptTemplate.context: Read memory HERO_LANDING_SPRINT_03_SECTIONS for detailed implementation guide. HeroSection, FeaturesSection, TestimonialsSection, CTASection.
tasks: 1. Create HeroSection.tsx with gradient bg from-medical-blue-light to-background, HIPAA badge, headline 'Occupational Health Reports Simplified', stats (24h, 99.9%, 500+), Request Demo/Watch Video CTAs, mock report card illustration (~85 lines)

2. Create FeaturesSection.tsx with 6 cards: Pre-Employment (Building2), Health Surveillance (Activity), 24-Hour Turnaround (Clock), HIPAA Compliant (Shield), Multi-Provider Network (Users), Digital Reports (FileText) (~75 lines)
3. Create TestimonialsSection.tsx with 3 testimonials: Dr. Sarah Chen/TechCorp, James Mitchell/BuildRight, Dr. Emily Rodriguez/SafeWork. Use Quote icon, Avatar component (~80 lines)
4. Create CTASection.tsx with full-width bg-medical-blue, headline about transformation, Get Started Today/Schedule a Call CTAs (~50 lines)
acceptanceCriteria: HeroSection has gradient background with medical blue
FeaturesSection shows 6 feature cards with icons
CTASection has full-width medical blue background
All sections use Container for consistent layout

parallelGroups.description: SignOutButton has no dependencies, can start immediately. SignInForm depends on phase-1 shadcn components.
SignInForm needs shadcn input/label from phase-1

tasks.description: Create SignInForm with loading spinner, friendly errors, flow toggle

sequentialTasks.description: Create AuthModal component wrapping SignInForm with Dialog

promptTemplate.context: Read memory HERO_LANDING_SPRINT_04_AUTH for detailed implementation guide. SignInForm, SignOutButton, AuthModal components. Uses @convex-dev/auth/react.
tasks: 1. Create SignInForm.tsx with email/password inputs, Loader2 spinner, friendlyErrors mapping, flow toggle (signIn/signUp), medical-blue focus rings, onSuccess callback (~95 lines)
2. Create SignOutButton.tsx that only renders when authenticated, uses signOut from @convex-dev/auth/react, optional LogOut icon (~25 lines)
3. Create AuthModal.tsx Dialog wrapper with Stethoscope icon header, controlled open state, closes on successful auth (~45 lines)
acceptanceCriteria: SignInForm has loading spinner during submission
SignInForm shows user-friendly error messages (friendlyErrors object)
SignInForm clears errors on input change
AuthModal can wrap any trigger element

sequentialTasks.description: Update NavigationBar to use AuthModal for Login/Request Demo buttons
Replace App.tsx with modular version using all components

promptTemplate.context: Read memory HERO_LANDING_SPRINT_05_INTEGRATION for detailed implementation guide. Final assembly of all components.
tasks: 1. Update NavigationBar.tsx: Import AuthModal, wrap Login button with AuthModal trigger, wrap Request Demo with AuthModal (initialFlow='signUp'), update both desktop and mobile menu sections

2. Replace App.tsx (~120 lines): Import layout (NavigationBar, Footer), landing (HeroSection, FeaturesSection, TestimonialsSection, CTASection), auth (AuthModal, SignOutButton). Create LandingPage, AuthenticatedNav, Dashboard internal components. Use Authenticated/Unauthenticated wrappers. Add floating Provider Login button in fixed position.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop/Mobile Login and Request Demo buttons wrapped in AuthModal
Floating Provider Login button in fixed position
Dashboard shows welcome message and demo stats
npm run dev serves landing page at localhost:5173

gateValidation.expectedOutcome: Typecheck exit 0, HTTP 200 from dev server

parallelGroups.description: Dev server setup must complete first

tasks.description: Start dev server on port 5175, verify Browser-CLI connection

parallelGroups.description: After server setup, most tests can run in parallel

tasks.description: Test landing page sections (Hero, Features, Testimonials, CTA, Footer)
Test auth modal flow (open, validation, login, signout)
Run accessibility audit, verify no critical violations

sequentialTasks.description: Save visual baselines (landing-hero, landing-features, landing-testimonials, landing-structure)

promptTemplate.context: Read memory HERO_LANDING_SPRINT_06_E2E_TESTING for detailed test scripts. Use Browser-CLI on port 5175. Test credentials in .env.local.
setup: 1. Check if port 5175 is free: lsof -ti:5175
2. Start dev server: VITE_PORT=5175 npm run dev:frontend (run in background)
tests: LANDING SECTIONS: Verify Hero (headline, HIPAA badge, stats, CTAs), Features (6 cards), Testimonials (3 cards), Footer (compliance badges). Take screenshots.
AUTH FLOW: Click Login, verify modal (form fields), test validation, enter credentials from .env.local (TEST_USER_NAME, TEST_PASSWORD), submit, verify dashboard, test sign out.
RESPONSIVE: resize 375 812 (mobile hamburger), resize 768 1024 (tablet), resize 1920 1080 (desktop). Screenshots at each breakpoint.
ACCESSIBILITY: auditAccessibility, getAccessibilityResults --format=summary, verify no critical violations.
acceptanceCriteria: All landing page sections render correctly
Auth modal opens and closes properly

executionOrder.parallelism: pg-1.1 parallel (task-1.1 + task-1.4), then sequential (task-1.2, task-1.3)
task-2.1 first, then pg-2.2 parallel (task-2.2 + task-2.3), then task-2.4
pg-3.1 all 4 sections parallel, then task-3.5
task-4.2 parallel with task-4.1, then task-4.3, then task-4.4
task-6.1 first, then pg-6.2 parallel (5 tests), then task-6.5 last

riskMitigations.mitigation: Run components one at a time, check package.json for conflicts after each

riskMitigations.risk: CSS variables may not apply in dark mode
riskMitigations.mitigation: Test dark mode toggle during phase 1, verify oklch values render correctly

riskMitigations.risk: Convex auth API may have changed
riskMitigations.mitigation: Read existing App.tsx before refactoring, verify @convex-dev/auth imports
Check lsof -ti:5175 before starting, kill existing process if needed

riskMitigations.risk: Browser-CLI may timeout on slow page loads
riskMitigations.mitigation: Increase wait durations, use waitForSelector with explicit timeouts

recommendations: For phases 1-5, spawn single developer agent per phase to maintain context continuity
Use run_in_background=true only for truly independent tasks within parallel groups
Always run typecheck gate before proceeding to next phase
For phase 6, browser agent should read .env.local for test credentials (TEST_USER_NAME, TEST_PASSWORD)
If a phase gate fails, document the error and retry before escalating
Save agent outputs to session directory for handoff continuity
